contested.reason: The only evidence (tc-261017_1-w2-d-07-73) is the title and author header of 2410.12500. The claimed specifics are not in the excerpt: ell_max = 5000, a Euclid-like survey, bias in Omega_m and S8 reduced to acceptable levels, and a modest increase in variance. No cite call with verbatim quotes was made (d-07 says cite was never run). The title supports only the method itself, a theoretical-error covariance.

The statement 'at most 2.5% at k=1 h/Mpc' is contradicted by f-014 in the same wave, where kappa_w=2 gives 2.92+/-0.15%. The conclusion that 'within its design range the emulator cannot approach' the required suppression overreaches: f-015 states that combined extremes were not sampled. The comparison is also not like-for-like. A_mod scales P_NL - P_L, so the implied 1 - P/P_DMO at k = 0.2-1 h/Mpc must be computed before it can be set against HACC ratios. None of the evidence contains that conversion.

The k=3 conclusion, 'low by a factor of about 2.1-2.3, or about 3.1-3.4 sigma, even at the edge of the HACC design range', is superseded by f-014 and f-015. The kappa_w=2 point gives 10.9% at k=3, about 2.4 sigma below 18.4% (lower error 3.1). The fiducial and strong points held kappa_w and M_seed fixed, so they are not at the edge of the design range. The arithmetic for the fiducial and strong points is correct. The 2309.02920 values rest on a title-only excerpt here and are carried over from f-009.

issues.text: The quoted phrases 'not as strong as inferred using KiDS data' and 'k ~ 0.2 h/Mpc' are attributed to the abstract, but the excerpt from tc-...-72 is cut off after the author affiliations. Only the conclusions chunk (tc-...-78) visibly supports 'stronger than favoured in recent hydrodynamic simulations'. The DES Y3 A_mod value is still unsourced, and 2305.09827 is not cited.

The visible excerpts support the fgas range from -10 to +4 sigma and the statement that only Illustris and cosmo-OWLS 8.7 are out of reach. The excerpts do not show the minimum positions (k=6 at z=2, k=10 at z=0), the saturation below fgas-8sigma, the Bigwood et al. compatibility, or the claim that Amon & Efstathiou is out of reach. These rest on the cite call. The depth of the FLAMINGO minimum is still open (q-08), and it is the benchmark most needed for comparing curve shapes.

The excerpts for every CSV are cut off at k of about 0.12 h/Mpc, so the k=1 and k=3 values cannot be checked against the quoted evidence. They are internally consistent with each other and with f-001. e_w, v_kin and eps_kin were only moved jointly, so their individual sensitivities are unknown. omega_m and sigma_8 were never varied, so the claimed cosmology independence of about 1% (FLAMINGO) has not been checked for HACC.

The task asks for the shape of the suppression up to about 10 h/Mpc, including the depth and position of the minimum, and this is still not delivered. All runs are still deepening at k=3.7 h/Mpc because of the CSV truncation (x-01, q-06). Without the curve above 3.7 h/Mpc, the comparison of minimum position against FLAMINGO (8-10 h/Mpc) and the explanation of the factor-2 gap at k=3 remain speculative.

f-002 is still contested on the board. Its claim that the k=1 suppression spans -0.2% to +2.5% across the full AGN design range is falsified by kappa_w=2 (2.92%). It should be formally retired in favour of f-015.

The weak-lensing assessment has no projected quantity. There is no C_ell or xi_+ suppression and no S8 shift. The only ell range comes from an unverified f-007 statement (ell_max = 5000). The lensing-weighted redshift of about 0.3-0.5 was never probed, since all HACC runs are at z=0.

At k=3 the joint lowering of e_w, v_kin and eps_kin (about -8.8 pp) is larger than the kappa_w spread (5.98 pp). kappa_w is the largest single-parameter one-at-a-time effect among those varied, not the largest effect sampled.

unsupported: This is consistent with the literature picture in which the concentration of baryons in halo centres dominates once ejective feedback is weak (arXiv:2309.02920). — The board sources 2309.02920 only for star formation concentrating baryons on small scales. Using it to explain an emulator enhancement at k~2.4 h/Mpc when feedback is weak is the report's own interpretation, not something the source states.

Three corner-style points cannot establish the emulator's maximum suppression. Report the result as 'largest suppression among the sampled points'. Alternatively, spend the spare calls on a few extra corners, for example with kappa_w and e_w at their bounds and the kinetic parameters varied, before claiming that HACC cannot reach 10% at k=1.

Step 1 must confirm, before any run, that every value lies inside the describe_parameters bounds. This applies to e_w=1.0, v_kin=1.2, eps_kin=1.2, M_seed=2.0 and the cosmology omega_m=0.14, sigma_8=0.8. Points at the corners of the design hypercube carry the largest emulator error, so the 1-sigma must be quoted next to every ratio. Do not silently extrapolate.

Confirm the emulator's k units (h/Mpc or 1/Mpc) before comparing with HSC-XXL, eROSITA+kSZ and 2309.02920. Sigma comparisons should combine the emulator 1-sigma and the observational error in quadrature, and the method should be stated. The HSC-XXL and eROSITA+kSZ numbers (5+/-4% and 10+/-2%) currently have no source arXiv ID or validated citation. Add them to d-10, or drop the sigma claims.

Check that predict_observable supports z=1 for Pk-ratio. If only a nearby redshift is available, label it with its exact value. FLAMINGO's redshift trend should be compared only qualitatively, because the parameterisations differ.

The cutoff at k=3.7 h/Mpc may be the emulator's training k_max rather than a truncation by the text reader. Check describe_parameters or list_observables for the Pk-ratio k range first. If k_max is about 3.7, record that the high-k minimum and the upturn are outside the emulator's validity, and skip the CSV-reading attempts. Any extrapolated value is unverifiable.

Confirm the fGas mass-bin range and units (Msun versus Msun/h, and M500 versus M200) before reading off values at about 1e14. A monotonicity claim based on four points is qualitative only. Use the same four parameter points as the Pk-ratio runs so the pairing is like-for-like. The call budget is tight (about 11 calls): drop the plot_prediction step if needed.

Neither 2512.02954 nor 2309.02920 is in the brief's key-paper list. Verify both with get_arxiv_metadata before citing. Four cite calls plus several read_arxiv_chunk and get_paper_figures calls may exceed 13. Prioritise the A_mod quote, the FLAMINGO minimum and the S8-shift numbers, in that order.

The weak-lensing impact assessment has no quantitative tool, since no Limber or Fisher code is available. Extend d-10 to pull verbatim S8 or Omega_m shift values from 1407.4301, 1105.1075 or 2410.12500 for a DMO fit versus a baryonic fit. The S8-bias part of the task then rests on cited numbers rather than inference from the emulator's S(k).

contested.reason: The Pk-ratio values agree with the maxsupp CSV (tc-...-45). The Grandis et al. comparison uses only the emulator std (0.002 at k=1, 0.0065 at k=3) and leaves out the published errors (+0.012/-0.014 and +0.026/-0.031). Adding both in quadrature gives about 0.4-0.5 sigma at k=1 and about 1.7 sigma at k=3, not 3 and 8 sigma. The 3.2 sigma shortfall against eROSITA+kSZ rests on the 10+/-2% value, which is not shown verbatim in the f-020 evidence.

The strongAGN point changes e_w (0.6 to 1.0) as well as v_kin and eps_kin. The 0.3-0.8 pp difference therefore cannot be credited to kinetic feedback alone. The quoted excerpts show only rows with k<0.12, so the k=1, 3 and 3.7 values are not visible in the evidence.
The excerpt from tc-...-42 contains only the title, author list and page header. Neither 10+/-2% (eROSITA+kSZ) nor 5+/-4% (HSC-XXL) appears in it. f-024 depends on these numbers.
The excerpt from tc-...-36 ends partway through the abstract. The values 0.042, 0.184 and k<0.37 h/Mpc at 97.5% credibility are not in the quoted text. These numbers are used quantitatively in f-024.
Superseded by f-025, which gives the DES Y3 value A_mod = 0.858 +/- 0.052. The statement that this value 'was not in the portion read' is out of date and should be retired.

issues.text: The maximum suppression is not established. The maxsupp_lowkin and maxsupp_lowM CSVs exist but were never read. Cosmology was held at omega_m=0.14 and sigma_8=0.8, although the suppression depends on the cosmic baryon fraction. The kappa_w effect is confounded with M_seed: maxsupp (kappa_w=2, M_seed=2.0) and strongAGN (kappa_w=3, M_seed=1.3) differ in both. q-02 and q-10 remain unanswered.

The fGas CSVs were written but never read. The pairing of gas fraction with suppression is the central quantitative test of the AGN-physics explanation the task asks for, and reading the files costs about 3 tool calls.

The z=0 to z=1 trend has been measured for one point only; fiducial_z1 was not read. Two FLAMINGO statements are unsourced while q-08/q-13 stays open: the 'agrees with FLAMINGO' claim, and the statement that FLAMINGO's minimum lies at k~8-10 h/Mpc.
q-09 is unresolved. The P_grav reference used by HACC may differ from the P_DMO reference used in the literature, and this should be checked before the deficit at k=3 is interpreted.

The weak-lensing assessment is still qualitative. No numerical S8 shift has been extracted. The HACC suppression at k=0.2-0.5 has not been compared with the Preston et al. requirement that suppression extend to k~0.2 h/Mpc.
The k_max of about 12.6 h/Mpc and the plateau at about 0.789 are inferred from byte offsets; the quoted excerpt stops at k=9.70. Quote the final rows of the file verbatim.

contested.reason: The arithmetic checks out: 0.6/1.414 = 0.42, 5.4/3.18 = 1.70, 6.4/2.01 = 3.18 and 1.4/4.005 = 0.35. However, every input comes from unverified values. The 2512.02954 and 2309.02920 excerpts are cut off in the abstract or title block and do not contain 10+/-2%, 5+/-4%, 0.042 or 0.184. f-020 and f-021 are themselves contested. The 3.6% emulator value at k=1 is also not in the quoted maxsupp excerpt, which stops at k=0.117. The sigma values cannot be treated as established until q-14 is done.

The cited excerpt (tc-...-86, chars 40000-55000) shows only text about the covariance discussion. It does not contain Table 3 or any of the claimed numbers (-1.317, -5.690 sigma, 0.128, 0.057, 0.573, 1.459 sigma), nor the 'at least a 3 sigma offset' quote. The claim is marked high confidence and says the values were read verbatim, but the evidence as posted does not show them. A verbatim excerpt of the table rows is needed.

The f_gas values are supported by the excerpts. The paired S(k=1) and S(k=3) values (0.9779/0.9197 and 0.9746/0.9121) are not in the quoted Pk excerpts, which stop at k of about 0.1, and they reuse f-019, which is contested on the board. The conclusion also rests on two points that agree within errors and differ in e_w, v_kin and eps_kin together. That cannot support any statement about a van Daalen-type relation, including that the trend runs 'the wrong way'.

issues.text: Every literature-comparison significance on the board (f-024, f-029, f-036) depends on f-020 and f-021, and neither has been checked verbatim. The full texts are already on disk, so checking them is cheap. Until it is done, the headline conclusion that HACC falls short of eROSITA+kSZ by about 3 sigma is provisional.

The emulator values for lowM are supported. The comparisons to Siegel et al. and Grandis et al. inherit the contested status of f-020 and f-021. The claim that 'the design range does not reach eROSITA+kSZ' has only been tested at the kappa_w=2, e_w=1 corners with omega_m=0.14 and sigma_8=0.8. The lowM curve is still falling at k=3.7, so its minimum is unresolved. The cosmology axes (omega_m 0.12-0.155, sigma_8 0.7-0.9) were not explored, and they can shift the response through the baryon fraction and halo abundance.

There is a physically interesting signal here that the finding does not develop. Strong kinetic feedback leaves f_gas(<R500c) at 1.26e14 essentially unchanged (0.1214 vs 0.1221), yet it deepens S(k). That suggests the HACC suppression is driven by gas removal beyond R500c, or by other halo masses, rather than by the R500c gas fraction. A controlled single-parameter sweep is needed to test this.

Attributing the deeper suppression to 'kappa_w=2 vs kappa_w=3' is confounded, because M_seed also differs (2.0 vs 1.3). Note too that f-036 shows lower M_seed increases suppression. That makes the kappa_w attribution plausible, but it has not been isolated by changing one parameter at a time.

The weak-lensing assessment is still qualitative. There is no Delta S8 value (Table 4 of 2410.12500 is unread), the HACC k=0.2-0.3 values are interpolated rather than read, and there is no A_mod-equivalent number for any HACC point. Two directions in a row hit their budget limit before reading the files they had produced. Future reads should target narrow character ranges.

suggested_directions.goal: Quantify the weak-lensing relevance of the HACC suppression: read S(k) at k=0.2-0.5 for maxsupp and lowM, then convert it to an A_mod-equivalent and an approximate S8 shift.
suggested_directions.rationale: The weak-lensing part of the task is still qualitative. The A_mod comparison relies on interpolation, and no S8 bias has been tied to HACC S(k).
steps: Read the maxsupp and lowM Pk-ratio CSVs over chars 0-3000 (k up to about 0.5) and quote S at k=0.2, 0.3 and 0.5.

Compute the A_mod-equivalent at k of about 0.2-1 h/Mpc as A_eff = 1 - (1 - S)*P_NL/(P_NL - P_L), using linear and nonlinear P(k) from CAMB/halofit if available; otherwise, bound A_eff using published P_NL/P_L ratios.
Compare A_eff with A_mod = 0.858+/-0.052 (DES Y3) and A_mod of about 0.69 (KiDS-1000).
If a Python tool is available, run a simple Limber C_ell for a DES-Y3-like n(z) with and without the HACC lowM S(k), and estimate Delta S8 by template fitting of the amplitude.
Cross-check the result against the verified Delta S8 values from 2410.12500 Table 4.
